blocks.en: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage when participants react throughout a session. We introduce $μ$-Bench, a benchmark for joint task completion in closed-loop, full-duplex multi-user voice interaction. Simulated participants act from isolated profiles of goals, knowledge, and permissions, adapting to the agent's speech and tool outcomes. Across 20 domains, 100 scenarios vary group size, acoustics, and follow-up demands to form 800 cases (408 tool-augmented, 392 tool-free). Joint Task Success (JTS) requires all user goals, privacy boundaries, and terminal states to hold jointly, while Pure JTS further disallows unauthorized tool calls; Attribution, Threading, and Coordination (ATC) diagnostics localize failures. Across 13 voice agents, proprietary systems peak at 62.24\% tool-free and 65.44\% tool-augmented success, while open-weight models remain below 20\%. ATC diagnostics show that open-weight models lag primarily in multi-turn attribution and threading, and controlled contrasts reveal that larger groups consistently degrade joint task success across capable systems. By coupling reactive multi-user simulation with verifiable session-level outcomes, $μ$-Bench provides a rigorous testbed for shared voice agents.
blocks.zh: 共享空间中的语音代理必须满足相互依存的多用户请求,同时维护每个用户的权限、隐私和任务限制。 现有评价的覆盖面有限,因为参加者在整个会议期间都作出反应。 我们引入了$μ$-Bench,这是在闭路式,全复式多用户语音互动中完成联合任务的基准. 模拟参与者通过对目标、知识和权限的孤立描述采取行动,适应代理人的言论和工具结果。 在20个域中,100个场景不同组大小,声学,后续要求形成800个案例(408个工具增强,392个工具无). 联合任务成功(JTS)要求所有用户目标,隐私界限,和终端状态共同持有,而纯JTS进一步不允许未经授权的工具调用; Attribtion, Threading, 和协调(ATC)诊断将故障本地化. 13个语音代理,专有系统峰值为62.24QX无工具,65.44XX工具提升成功,而开放量级模型仍然低于20QX. ATC诊断显示,开量模型主要在多回合归属和线程上滞后,受控对比显示,较大的群体在有能力的系统中不断降低联合任务的成功率. 通过将反应式多用户模拟与可核查会话级结果相配合,$μ$-Bench为共享语音代理提供了严格的测试床.

blocks.en:
Voice agents in shared spaces must serve multiple users whose goals and constraints are often interdependent.
Over a single full-duplex audio channel, participants routinely interrupt the agent or speak over one another.
Consider a family traveling to the airport: a parent needs to arrive before 10:00, while a child interrupts to request a park detour amid ongoing chatter (Figure 1 ).
Assessing that detour requires checking whether the new route meets the deadline and obtaining the parent’s approval.
The agent must track who requested what, identify binding constraints, and reconcile competing goals within each participant’s authority.
blocks.zh:
共享空间中的语音代理必须服务于目标和制约因素往往相互依存的多个用户.
在单一的全复式音频频道上,与会者经常打断代理或相互交谈。
考虑一个家庭前往机场:父母需要10:00前抵达,而孩子则在不断的闲聊中打断请求绕道公园(图1)。
评估这一绕道需要检查新路线是否符合最后期限并获得家长的批准。
代理人必须跟踪谁要求什么,确定具有约束力的限制,并调和每个参与者权限内相互竞争的目标。

blocks.en:
In such settings, managing the interaction becomes inseparable from solving the task.
A clarification can reveal an unstated constraint, a refusal can prompt an authorized participant to intervene, and an intermediate tool result can change which plans remain feasible.
Because subsequent user turns depend directly on the agent’s speech and actions, evaluation must capture this live feedback and score the session as a whole.
Depending on the context, the appropriate response may be to fulfill a request, ask for clarification, refuse an unauthorized action, or ignore peer-directed side-talk.
Crucially, each such action must remain consistent with all other goals and constraints in the session.
blocks.zh:
在这种情况下,管理互动与解决任务密不可分。
澄清可以揭示未说明的限制,拒绝可以促使经授权的参与者进行干预,中间工具结果可以改变哪些计划仍然是可行的。
因为随后的用户转而直接依赖于代理的言论和行动,评价必须抓住这个活回馈,并对整个会话进行分数.
视上下文而定,适当的回应可能是满足请求,要求澄清,拒绝未经授权的行动,或忽略同行引导的侧口.
至关重要的是,每项此类行动都必须符合本届会议的所有其他目标和制约因素。

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks address important parts of this problem (Table 1 ). τ \tau -Voice and Joi-Bench-Task pair interactive voice simulation with verifiable tool execution, covering mid-task revisions, clarifications, and post-interruption recovery, but center on a single simulated user without independent multi-user goals or cross-user permissions ( Ray et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) . Similarly, DuplexLedger tests transactional memory updates over pre-authored dialogues with adaptive interruption timing and bystander speech ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
In multi-party settings, MP-Bench, Duplex-MPE, and MultiPartyTurnBench focus on turn-taking, selective participation, and distinguishing barge-ins from backchannels ( Shih et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Mathur and Manocha, 2026 ) , whereas MultiTalkBench evaluates long-horizon state tracking and participation in recorded group conversations ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
Closer to multi-user task constraints, MSI-Bench examines speaker-scoped memory, disclosure and authority rules, and one-shot tool-call prediction on prerecorded multi-party scenes ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) .
What remains underexplored is whether an agent can guide multiple participants with interdependent requests to a jointly valid outcome when its own questions, refusals, and tool actions shape what users say and decide next.
blocks.zh:
现有基准涉及这一问题的重要部分(表1)。 \tau-Voice和Joi-Bench-Task配对交互式语音模拟,具有可核查的工具执行功能,涵盖任务中期修改,澄清,以及中断后恢复,但以单个模拟用户为中心,没有独立的多用户目标或交叉用户权限(Ray等,2026;He等,2026). 同样地,"双解"编辑器测试交易内存更新,比起前作的有适应性中断时间和旁观者演讲的对话(Li等,2026).
在多党环境下,MP-Bench,Duplex-MPE,和多党Turn Bench注重回合制,选择性参与,并区分出驳船与后道(Shih等,2026;Ma等,2026;Mathur和Manocha,2026),而Multalk Bench则评价长距离状态跟踪和参与所记录的团体对话(Wang等,2026b.).
在接近多用户任务限制的情况下,MSI-Bench检查了扩音器的内存,披露和权威规则,以及对预先录制的多党场景的一发一发工具调用预测(Xiong等,2026年).
仍未充分探讨的是,当一个代理人提出自己的问题、拒绝和工具行动决定了用户所说的话和下一步的决定时,该代理人是否能够指导多个参与者提出相互依存的要求,以获得共同有效的结果。

blocks.en:
To address this gap, we introduce μ \mu -Bench to evaluate multi-user task completion through closed-loop voice interaction.
Each scenario specifies participant profiles, goals, permissions, and interaction events.
During a session, simulated participants generate contextual responses from their private information and the public dialogue they have heard.
An orchestrator schedules events and bounded follow-up exchanges as the conversation evolves.
The benchmark spans 100 base scenarios across 20 everyday and professional domains, split between 51 tool-augmented and 49 tool-free scenarios.
Tool-augmented tasks test whether agents uphold multi-user constraints during live backend execution, while the shared tool-free track isolates spoken coordination and enables direct comparison with speech models that lack tool-calling support.
Varying three binary condition axes (group size, acoustic realism, and follow-up demands) expands these scenarios into 800 evaluation cases and enables matched within-scenario comparisons.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了μ\mu-Bench,通过闭路语音交互来评价多用户任务完成情况.
每种方案都具体规定参与者简介、目标、权限和互动活动。
在一次会议期间,模拟参与者从其私人信息和他们听到的公开对话中产生背景反应。
随着对话的发展,一个管弦乐团会安排各种事件和有界限的后续交流.
该基准涵盖20个日常和专业领域的100个基本假设,分为51个工具强化假设和49个无工具假设。
工具强化任务测试代理在直播后端执行期间是否坚持多用户限制,而共享的无工具音轨隔离了口语协调,并能够直接与缺乏工具调用支持的语音模型进行比较.
不同的三个二进制条件轴(组大小,声响现实主义,以及后续需求)将这些假想扩展为800个评价案例,并能够进行场内对比.

blocks.en:
Our primary metric is Joint Task Success (JTS) : all required user goals, privacy boundaries, and outcome-level constraints must hold jointly within the same trajectory.
Scoring combines programmatic checks on states and tool logs with semantic judgments of recorded responses.
Fulfilling one participant’s request cannot compensate for a privacy breach, a missed refusal, or an unresolved requirement elsewhere in the session. In tool-augmented tasks, we further audit unauthorized or misattributed tool executions separately and combine them with JTS into Pure JTS (Section 5.3 ), exposing agents that reach valid end states through unauthorized execution paths.
To diagnose failure modes, we report three complementary diagnostics ( ATC ): Attribution (addressee routing, participant-role grounding, and request ownership in spoken responses), Threading (maintaining, updating, and resuming user-specific and shared tasks), and Coordination (authorization and privacy compliance alongside service equity).
blocks.zh:
我们的首要衡量标准是“联合任务成功”(JTS):所有需要的用户目标、隐私界限和结果层面的限制必须在同一轨迹内共同存在。
对所记录的答复进行语义判断后,对状态和工具日志进行程序检查。
满足一名参加者的要求不能补偿侵犯隐私、错过拒绝或会议其他地方未解决的要求。 在工具强化的任务中,我们进一步分别审计未经授权或错误分配的工具处决,并将其与JTS合并为纯JTS(第5.3节),暴露通过未经授权的处决途径到达有效终点状态的特工.
为了诊断故障模式,我们报告三种补充诊断(ATC): 归属(地址路由、参与者-角色定位和在口头答复中请求所有权)、线索(维护、更新和恢复用户专用和共享的任务)和协调(授权和隐私合规以及服务公平)。

blocks.en:
We evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight voice agents and find wide capability gaps across both tracks: leading proprietary systems peak at 62.24% Joint Task Success on the tool-free track and 65.44% on tool-augmented tasks, while open-weight models remain below 20% (led by MiniCPM-o 4.5 at 19.39%).
ATC diagnostics show that open-weight models combine high boundary compliance with weak multi-turn attribution and threading, and controlled contrasts reveal that increasing group size consistently degrades Joint Task Success across capable systems.
A cumulative assistance study on MiniCPM-o 4.5 further shows that serializing overlapping speech and supplying turn-level identity and semantic cues raises Joint Task Success by 61.84% relative, yet still leaves 68.62% of sessions unresolved and points to multi-party planning bottlenecks beyond acoustic concurrency.
Our contributions are: • A closed-loop task formulation and reactive multi-user simulator that links private participant goals, knowledge, and permissions to live spoken interaction. • A suite of 800 controlled cases across 20 domains, combining joint session-level success criteria with Attribution, Threading, and Coordination diagnostics. • An empirical evaluation of 13 proprietary and open-weight voice agents via dual-track comparisons, condition contrasts, and cumulative assistance, characterizing failures across concurrent and assisted settings.
blocks.zh:
我们评价13个专有和开放式语音代理,发现两条轨道存在巨大能力差距:领先的专有系统在无工具轨道上达到62.24%的联合任务成功率和65.44%在工具强化任务上达到高峰,而开放式的权重模型仍然低于20%(由MiniCPM-o 4.5牵头,占19.39%)。
ATC诊断显示,开放量模型结合了高边界合规度与弱多回合归属和线程,受控对比显示,群体大小的不断增大会使跨能力系统的联合任务成功降低.
有关MiniCPM-o 4.5的累计援助研究进一步显示,将重叠的语音序列化并提供倒转式身份和语义提示,使联合任务成功率相对上升了61.84%,但仍有68.62%的会议未解决,并表明多党派规划瓶颈超出了声学通量。
我们的贡献是: 一个闭路任务制定和反应式多用户模拟器,将私人参与者的目标、知识和进行口头互动的权限联系起来。 二. 支助 • 将联合会议一级的成功标准与分配、线索和协调诊断相结合。 通过双轨比较、条件对比和累积协助,对13个专有和开放式语音代理机构进行实证评价,说明同时存在和受援环境的失败。

blocks.en:
As summarized in Table 1 , early full-duplex benchmarks like the Full-Duplex-Bench series and HumDial-FDBench measure acoustic turn-taking, latency, and interruption handling ( Lin et al., 2025b ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , while DuplexLedger tests transactional memory operations (write, update, ignore, and retain) over pre-authored dialogues with online-adapted interruption and backchannel timing ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
Beyond turn-taking and memory, interactive agent benchmarks such as ToolSandbox, τ \tau -Voice, and Joi-Bench-Task couple online user simulation with executable backends to test end-to-end task completion, covering clarifications, mid-task priority changes, request additions or withdrawals, and post-interruption recovery ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Ray et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) .
However, these protocols center on a single primary user: even when secondary voices appear, they are treated as acoustic distractors ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) rather than independent co-participants with private goals, distinct permissions, and joint completion requirements.
blocks.zh:
如表1所概述,早期的全复基准,如"全复通"-"奔驰"系列和"HumDial-FDBench"测量声学取转,延缓和中断处理(Lin等,2025b;Lin等,2026a;Lin等,2025a;Wang等,2026a等),而"双复通"测试交易存储器操作(写作,更新,忽略,并保留)超过预发式的对话,与在线调整的中断和回通道计时(Li等,2026).
除了取回转接和内存外,TolleSandbox,\\tau-Voice等交互式代理基准,以及Joi-Bench-Task夫妇在线用户模拟,使用可执行后端来测试端到端任务完成情况,涵盖澄清,中位任务优先级更改,请求添加或取回,以及中断后恢复(Lu等,2025;Ray等,2026;He等,2026).
然而,这些协议以单一的初级用户为中心:即使二级声音出现,它们也被视为声学分心器(Lin等,2026;Li等,2026),而不是具有私人目标,不同权限,以及联合完成要求的独立共同参与者.

blocks.en:
Recent multi-party benchmarks examine distinct facets of shared-channel interaction without testing closed-loop multi-user task completion.
For floor control and selective participation, MP-Bench assesses turn-taking awareness, response appropriateness, and comprehension QA ( Shih et al., 2026 ) ; Duplex-MPE pairs explicit and implicit addressing to measure selective responding, silence preservation, and stopping once a human resolves a request ( Ma et al., 2026 ) ; and MultiPartyTurnBench tests end-of-turn detection, interruption detection, and selective floor yielding across 2–5 speakers ( Mathur and Manocha, 2026 ) .
Yet none of these benchmarks trace how turn-level decisions govern downstream task execution.
In long-horizon group settings, MultiTalkBench uses human-recorded bilingual conversations to evaluate character state tracking, information integration, and role-appropriate participation ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , but does not test reactive task progression against executable outcomes.
Closer to memory scoping and authorization, component studies examine speaker-attributed memory and access control ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Al-Ratrout et al., 2026 ) , while MSI-Bench tests speaker-scoped memory, disclosure and authority rules, and tool-call prediction on prerecorded multi-party scenes ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) .
In contrast, μ \mu -Bench closes the loop for reactive multi-user task completion: independent participants adapt to the agent’s questions, refusals, and tool outcomes, and success requires jointly satisfying all user goals and cross-user constraints.

离内存范围界定和授权更近一些,组成部分研究则审查演讲者属性的内存和访问控制(徐等,2026;Al-Ratrout等,2026;而MSI-Bench测试演讲者范围内存,披露和权威规则,以及预录多方场景上的工具召唤预测(Xiong等,2026.
相比之下,μ\mu - Bench关闭了被动多用户任务完成的循环:独立参与者适应代理商的问题,拒绝,和工具结果,成功需要共同满足所有用户目标和交叉用户限制.

blocks.en: μ \mu -Bench frames multi-user voice assistance as a closed-loop benchmark that pairs a reactive participant simulator with a hybrid, provenance-verified evaluation protocol (Figure 2 ).

blocks.en: Because prerecorded scenes and fixed scripts cannot react to an agent’s questions, refusals, or tool outcomes, μ \mu -Bench closes the loop with a modular Multi-User Simulator (Figure 2 , left) that combines scenario-level pacing with strictly isolated, reactive participant agents.
blocks.zh: 由于预先录制的场景和固定脚本无法对代理商的问题,拒绝,或工具结果作出反应,μ\mu-Bench用模块化的多用户模拟器(图2,左)来关闭循环,该模拟器将场景级别间隔与严格隔离,反应性的参与者代理结合.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of the μ \mu -Bench simulation and evaluation framework. Left (Multi-User Simulator): Guided by a Playbook , the Orchestrator tracks Live feedback to trigger events, while each isolated User i i Simulator combines its private Character Profile and Audible History to generate reactive, character-specific speech over a full-duplex channel. Right (Evaluation Protocol): Grounded in the Task Contract and Recorded Evidence , two independent semantic reviews with arbitration and deterministic programmatic checks jointly yield binary Joint Task Success and ATC Diagnostics .
blocks.zh: 图2:μ\mu-Bench模拟与评价框架概述. 左边( 多用户模拟器) : 在游戏本的指引下, 活回馈来触发事件,而每个被孤立的User i i模拟器则结合其私自的"人物简介"和"可听取的历史",通过一个全复通的频道生成反应性,字符特异性的演讲. 右 (评价协议): 以任务合同和记录证据为基础,通过仲裁和确定性方案检查进行两项独立的语义审查,联合产生二进制联合任务成功和ATC诊断。

blocks.en: Guided by a scenario Playbook (participants, goals, authority, and event graph), the Orchestrator continuously monitors Live feedback from the full-duplex audio channel and executable environment to update session state, trigger scheduled events, and dispatch bounded follow-ups when requests remain unresolved.
blocks.zh: 以情景游戏手册(参与者、目标、权威和事件图表)为指导,Orchestrator持续监测 来自完整多功能音频通道和可执行环境的直播反馈,以更新会话状态,触发已排定的事件,并在请求仍未解决时发送有限制的后继.

blocks.en: Rather than replaying scripted lines, each participant runs in an isolated simulator that synthesizes context-adaptive speech from three inputs: a private Character Profile (goal, persona, voice, and authority), the Orchestrator ’s dispatched event, and a personal Audible History , which records only public speech heard while present (including truncated agent audio after barge-ins). Driven by the Scriptwriter and Voice Actor , participants naturally clarify constraints, contest unauthorized actions, and adapt to intermediate tool results in real time.
blocks.zh: 每个参与者不重复播放脚本行,而是在一个孤立的模拟器中运行,该模拟器从三个投入中合成了上下文调整的语音:一个私人字符简介(目标,人物,语音,和权威), Orchestrator的被发送事件,以及一个个人的可听取历史,它只记录了在场时听到的公开语音(包括驳船后短音). 由编剧和声优演员所推动,参与者自然澄清限制,竞争未经授权的行动,并实时适应中间工具结果.

blocks.en: Logical time pauses during planning and synthesis to keep the full-duplex timeline synchronized ( Ray et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 逻辑时间在规划和合成期间会暂停,以保持全复时段同步(Ray等,2026.

blocks.en: To reflect real-world breadth while enabling controlled stress testing, μ \mu -Bench spans 20 everyday and professional domains comprising 100 base scenarios : 51 tool-augmented scenarios requiring live backend state updates (e.g., flight rebooking, shared smart-home control, invoice updates) and 49 tool-free scenarios testing spoken coordination (e.g., roommate side-talk, medical privacy, trip negotiation; see Figure 1 and Appendix A for the full taxonomy).
blocks.zh: 为了反映现实世界的宽度,同时允许控制下的压力测试,μ\mu-Bench跨越了20个日常和专业领域,包括100个基本情景:51个工具强化情景,需要实时后端状态更新(如飞行再预订,共享智能家庭控制,发票更新)和49个无工具情景测试口语协调(如室友侧谈,医疗隐私,出行谈判;完整分类学见图1和附录A).

blocks.en:
Each base scenario is instantiated across a 2 3 2^{3} factorial grid: 𝐝 = ( d pop , d ac , d follow ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } 3 , \mathbf{d}=(d^{\mathrm{pop}},d^{\mathrm{ac}},d^{\mathrm{follow}})\in\{0,1\}^{3}, (2) varying user population (2–3 vs. 4–7 participants), acoustic realism (clean close-talk vs. speech with natural disfluencies), and follow-up demands (direct comprehension vs. repeated clarification and confirmation).
Crossing all 100 scenarios with these 8 configurations yields 800 evaluation cases (408 tool-augmented and 392 tool-free), supporting exact within-scenario matched contrasts along each axis.
Accordingly, μ \mu -Bench evaluates tool-capable agents across both the Tool-Augmented (408 cases) and Tool-Free (392 cases) tracks, while using the common Tool-Free track for fair comparison across all speech models (Section 4.1 ).

blocks.en: μ \mu -Bench evaluates each recorded trajectory and state transition ( State 0 → State T \mathrm{State}_{0}\to\mathrm{State}_{T} ) through a hybrid verification pipeline anchored in the Task Contract (Figure 2 , right).
blocks.zh: μ\mu - Bench通过基于任务合同(图2,右)的混合核查管道,对每个记录的轨迹和状态过渡(state 0 → state T\mathrm{ state \0\\\\\\ mathrm{ state })进行评估。

blocks.en: An LLM judge audits every goal disposition, privacy boundary, and capability assertion item by item. A second independent review re-evaluates all items in a fresh, isolated context, with disagreements resolved by anonymized arbitration. Whenever fabrication or missing context is flagged, targeted Source Grounding retrieves the delivered inputs and registered turns to catch judge oversights.
blocks.zh: LLM法官按项目对每个目标处置、隐私界限和能力断言项目进行审计。 第二次独立审查在新的孤立背景下重新评估所有项目,通过匿名仲裁解决了分歧。 只要标出编造或缺失的背景,目标源入地就收回已交付的投入并进行注册转会,以抓住法官的监督。

blocks.en: Objective validators verify executed system behavior directly: every tool call must bind a declared requester identity checked against runtime access-control and domain rules; strict temporal causality ensures future utterances never retroactively justify earlier actions; and semantic final-state comparison verifies effective outcomes while accepting both valid execution paths (acting early and revising upon updates, or waiting for consensus to execute once).
blocks.zh: 客观验证者直接验证已执行的系统行为:每个工具调用必须结合运行时访问控制和域规则来约束已宣布的被请求者身份;严格的时间因果关系确保未来言论永远不能追溯证明先前行动的合理性;语义上的最终状态比较验证有效结果,同时接受有效的执行路径(在更新后及早行动并修订,或等待共识执行一次).

blocks.en:
From these verified item outcomes, programmatic aggregation computes binary Joint Task Success (Eq. 1 ) alongside three decoupled ATC diagnostic axes: Attribution (addressee routing, participant-role grounding, discourse provenance, and spoken return anchoring), Threading (multi-turn state retention and resumption), and Coordination (averaging permission and privacy Isolation with cross-user Equity , or using Isolation alone when equity does not apply).
Implementation details, denominators, and termination rules appear in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
从这些经核实的项目结果中,方案汇总计算出二进制联合任务成功率(Eq. 1)和三个脱钩的ATC诊断轴: 归属(地址路由、参与者角色定位、话语出处和语音回放主播)、线程(多回合状态保留和恢复)和协调(与交叉用户权益进行授权和隐私隔离,或在权益不适用时单独使用隔离)。
实施细节、分母和终止规则载于附录B。

blocks.en:
We evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight voice agents on μ \mu -Bench to establish baseline performance across both evaluation tracks.
We detail the experimental setup (Section 4.1 ) and main JTS and ATC results across model families and tool settings (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们评价了 μ\ mu - Bench上的13个专有和开放量的语音代理商,以确立两个评价轨道的基线性能。
我们详细介绍了实验设置(第4.1节)以及示范家庭和工具设置的主要JTS和ATC结果(第4.2节)。

We benchmark 13 voice agents across two categories:

blocks.en: To assess both stateful tool execution and spoken interaction across model architectures, μ \mu -Bench organizes evaluation into two tracks: • Tool-Augmented Track: Four tool-capable proprietary systems (GPT-Realtime-2, Gemini 3.8 Live, Grok Voice 3.0, and Seeduplex 3.0) are evaluated on scenarios requiring live backend state updates alongside spoken coordination. • Tool-Free Track: All 13 systems, including MOSS-Live and the eight open-weight models, are evaluated on the 49 tool-free base scenarios across all 2 3 = 8 2^{3}=8 factorial conditions, isolating spoken coordination without tool-calling interfaces. Because MOSS-Live’s tool-calling support was released after our evaluation cutoff, we will incorporate its Tool-Augmented results in a forthcoming update.

blocks.en: Each system is evaluated under its official audio interface and recommended inference configuration. User speech is synthesized at 16 kHz PCM using Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512 with deterministic per-case voice bindings and orchestrated on a 200 ms logical tick. Formal task windows are capped at 1,800 s of logical time and 600 s of bilateral silence, with up to two closure-triggered follow-up rounds. User scriptwriting and closure control use gpt-6-luna ( T = 0.2 T=0.2 ), played agent audio is transcribed with Whisper large-v3 ( faster-whisper ), and semantic auditing and arbitration use gpt-6-luna ( T = 0 T=0 ).

On the common Tool-Free track, Table 2 separates evaluated systems into two clear tiers: proprietary agents reach 37.50–62.24% JTS (led by Grok Voice 3.0 at 62.24%), supported by substantially stronger Attribution (61.05–68.61%) and Threading (71.32–81.66%).
In contrast, all eight open-weight models remain below 20% JTS (peaking at 19.39% for MiniCPM-o 4.5, with six models at or below 3.57% and Threading under 9%).
Even on purely spoken tasks, low-latency full-duplex turn-taking alone does not translate into reliable multi-user task completion.

在通用的无工具轨道上,表2将评价的系统分为两个明确的层级:专有代理达到37.50-62.24%的JTS(由Grok Voice 3.0领导,占62.24%),辅以显著更强的归属(61.05-68.61%)和线索(71.32-81.66%)。

即使是纯粹的口头任务,低常态的完全复杂的转接本身并不能转化为可靠的多用户任务完成.

blocks.en:
Comparing Threading against Coordination across open-weight models reveals an important diagnostic gap: although six open-weight models score at most 3.57% JTS and 8.07% Threading, all eight achieve high Coordination scores between 76.43% and 87.17%.
Even Freeze-Omni (0.00% JTS, 0.00% Threading) and FLM-Audio (0.00% JTS, 0.61% Threading) record 76.43% and 79.33% Coordination.
Because Coordination averages permission and privacy compliance with service equity, models that attend mainly to the latest audio segment and drop earlier context passively avoid leaking prior users’ information or taking unauthorized actions, even as multi-turn task threads break down.
Scoring Coordination without Threading and JTS would therefore overstate multi-user capability.

将全开放重量模型的线索与协调进行比较,可以发现一个重要的诊断差距:虽然六个开放重量模型的得分最多为3.57%的JTS和8.07%的线索,但所有八个模型都取得了76.43%至87.17%的高协调分。
甚至冻结-Omni(0.00% JTS,0.0% Threading)和FLM-Audio(0.00% JTS,0.61% Threading)也记录了76.43%和79.33%的协调.
因为协调平均许可和隐私遵守服务公平性,所以主要关注最新音频段并被动地降低更早上下文的模型即使随着多回合任务线断裂,也避免了先前用户信息泄露或采取未经授权的行动.
因此,没有线索和JTS的分红协调将过分强调多用户能力。

blocks.en:
Across all four tool-capable proprietary agents, Coordination drops markedly from the Tool-Free track (96.06–97.11%) to the Tool-Augmented track (55.98–83.29%), most sharply on Seeduplex 3.0 and Gemini 3.8 Live.
Whereas cautious phrasing can hedge around ambiguity in spoken dialogue, live tool calls require explicit, owner-bound state updates that expose cross-user authority and equity conflicts.
Relative rankings also invert across tracks: Grok Voice 3.0 leads Tool-Free (62.24%) yet trails on Tool-Augmented (57.60%), whereas GPT-Realtime-2 (65.44%) and Gemini 3.8 Live (64.95%) lead once backend tools are required.
Evaluating spoken coordination and live tool execution side by side is therefore essential.

在所有四个具有工具能力的专利代理中,协调从无工具轨道(96.06-97.11%)明显下降至有工具强化轨道(55.98-83.29%),最显著的是Seeduplex 3.0和双子座 3.8 Live。
虽然谨慎的用词可以绕过口头对话的模糊性,但直播工具的呼声需要明确、受所有者约束的状态更新,从而暴露跨用户权威和公平冲突。
相对排名也跨道倒数:Grok Voice 3.0领先"工具-无"(62.24%),而"工具-增强"(57.60%)上的线索,而"GPT-Realtime-2"(65.44%)和"双子座活"(64.95%)在需要后端工具时领先.
因此,必须同时评估口语协调和活的工具执行。

blocks.en:
To separate full-duplex concurrency and perception challenges from core multi-party planning, we conduct a cumulative assistance study on MiniCPM-o 4.5, our strongest open-weight baseline on the Tool-Free track (Figure 4 ).
The three interventions are applied cumulatively so that each gain is measured on top of the preceding stages.
All stages retain the original spoken audio inputs, user goals, cross-user constraints, and session-level completion criteria, releasing auxiliary signals strictly turn by turn without exposing future turns or reference solutions: • Serialized Interaction: Converts overlapping speech and barge-ins into sequential turns while preserving all requests, corrections, and objections. • + Identity Metadata: Adds ground-truth metadata per turn specifying active speaker, addressee, request ownership, and task thread. • + Structured Semantics: Adds structured representations of the speaker’s goal, operation, parameters, constraints, and active permission scope after each spoken turn, leaving multi-user conflict resolution and task execution to the agent.
blocks.zh:
为了将完全复杂的货币和观念挑战与多方核心规划区分开来,我们对MiniCPM-o 4.5进行了累积援助研究,这是我们在无工具轨道上最强的开放量基线(图4)。
三项干预措施累积适用,以便在前几个阶段的基础上衡量每项收益。
所有阶段都保留了原有的口语音频输入,用户目标,跨用户限制,以及会话级完成标准,在不暴露未来转折或参考解决方案的情况下严格地通过转折释放辅助信号: • 串行互动: 在保留所有请求、更正和反对意见的同时,将重叠的语音和驳接转换为相继转接。 • + 身份元数据: 每个回合增加地面真实元数据,指定活动发言者、收件人、请求所有权和任务线索。 • + 结构语义: 在每次演讲后增加演讲者目标、操作、参数、限制和主动许可范围的结构化表述,将多用户冲突的解决和任务执行留给代理人。

Converting overlapping speech and barge-ins into sequential turns raises JTS by +7.40 pp (from 19.39% to 26.79%, Figure 4 ), accounting for over 60% of the total ablation gain.

归属(+16.72 pp)和线程(+15.08 pp)并列跳出,证实实时声学同位素驱动了一大部分基线故障.

Adding ground-truth identity metadata and structured semantics yields smaller incremental gains (+2.81 pp and +1.79 pp, reaching 31.38% JTS overall).
Even with Coordination at 90.24%, 68.62% of multi-user sessions remain unsolved .
Maintaining shared task state, reconciling interdependent goals, and enforcing cross-user constraints therefore remain hard even when overlapping speech is serialized and explicit identity and semantic cues are supplied, making μ \mu -Bench a diagnostic testbed across both concurrent and assisted settings.

因此,保持共同的任务状态,调和相互依存的目标,强制实施交叉用户限制,即使重叠的语音序列化,提供明确的身份和语义提示,使μ\mu-Bench成为同时存在和辅助存在的诊断试验床。

blocks.en: 5.3 Unauthorized Tool Execution Behind Apparent JTS
blocks.zh: 5.3 外观JTS背后未经授权的工具执行

blocks.en:
Because tool frameworks trust agent-declared requester identities without speaker verification, an agent can still pass outcome-level JTS checks by invoking tools under another user’s identity or beyond a speaker’s scope.
To separate such unauthorized execution paths from functional completion, we track unauthorized tool executions ( n n ), counting every business-tool call whose declared requester or executed scope conflicts with the speaker’s actual intent and authority (measured separately from speaker-attribution errors).
As shown in Figure 5 a, unauthorized executions occur in 21.81–71.81% of Tool-Augmented episodes across the four tool-capable agents, reaching 71.81% for Seeduplex 3.0.
Crucially, these violations often remain hidden in nominally successful runs: episodes with one unauthorized call ( n = 1 n=1 ) still reach 39.02–61.64% conditional JTS.
blocks.zh:
由于工具框架由代理人宣布的请求者身份无需发言人验证,因此代理人仍可以通过在另一个用户身份下或发言人范围之外使用工具,通过结果级JTS检查.
为了区分这种未经授权的行刑途径与功能完成,我们追踪未经授权的工具行刑(nnn),计及每一个被宣布为请求者或执行范围与演讲者的实际意图和权威相冲突的商业工具呼叫(与演讲者分配错误分开衡量)。
如图5a所示,在4个工具能代理中,21.81-71.81%的工具能增强事件发生,Seeduple 3.0达到71.81%。
关键是,这些侵权行为往往仍然隐藏在名义上成功的运行中:一次未经授权的呼叫(n=1n=1)的事件仍然达到39.02-61.64%有条件的JTS.

(b) 在要求零未经授权的处决(纯JTS,填充圈)之前(打开圈子)和之后使用工具强化JTS,每箭头上标有百分点。

blocks.en:
Outcome-level scoring (JTS) therefore masks substantial execution-path authorization risk.
To evaluate accountable completion, Figure 5 b reports Pure JTS , which requires both JTS and zero unauthorized executions ( n = 0 n=0 ) over all evaluated episodes.
Enforcing this standard lowers Tool-Augmented JTS by 11.0–24.0 percentage points across all four agents, whereas Tool-Free scores remain unchanged because no backend tools are invoked.
Accounting for unauthorized calls also reshapes system comparisons: GPT-Realtime-2 (65.4%) and Gemini 3.8 Live (65.0%) appear nearly tied under standard JTS, yet Pure JTS opens a clear gap (52.5% vs. 46.8%), pulling Gemini 3.8 Live close to Grok Voice 3.0 (46.6%) while Seeduplex 3.0 drops from 50.0% to 26.0% ( − 24.0 -24.0 pp).
Evaluating Pure JTS alongside JTS thus exposes a critical reliability gap: current voice agents often reach the right outcome through unauthorized execution paths.
blocks.zh:
因此,结果一级的评分掩盖了执行-途径核准的重大风险。
为了评价责任完成情况,图5b报告纯JTS,它要求对所有评价事件进行JTS和零未经授权的处决(n=0n=0)。
强制实施这一标准将工具强化JTS在所有四个代理中降低11.0–24.0个百分点,而工具自由分则保持不变,因为没有引用后端工具.
未经授权的电话的计算也重塑了系统比较:GPT-Realtime-2(65.4%)和双子座3.8 Live(65.0%)在标准JTS下几乎是捆绑的,然而纯JTS打开了明显的缺口(52.5%对46.8%),将双子座3.8 Live拉近了Grok Voice 3.0(46.6%),而Seeduple 3.0从50.0%下降到26.0%(24.0-24.0页)。
因此,评估纯JTS与JTS同时存在,暴露出一个关键的可靠性差距:当前语音代理经常通过未经授权的行刑路径达到正确的结果.

blocks.en:
We introduced μ \mu -Bench, a closed-loop benchmark for evaluating multi-user task completion in shared full-duplex voice agents.
Moving beyond single-user assumptions, local turn-taking checks, and static audio traces, μ \mu -Bench pairs a reactive multi-user simulator with verifiable environment execution across 20 domains and 800 factorial cases (408 tool-augmented and 392 tool-free).
By requiring all outcome-level goals and constraints to hold jointly (JTS), auditing tool-call provenance via Pure JTS , and pairing them with Attribution , Threading , and Coordination ( ATC ) diagnostics, μ \mu -Bench isolates how shared-space dynamics govern practical task execution.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了 μ\ mu - Bench, 一个用于评估多用户任务完成的闭路基准, 共享的全复通语音代理 。
μ\mu-Bench对一反应式多用户模拟器,在20个领域和800个因子案件中可核查环境执行(408个工具增强和392个工具无),超越了单用户假设,局部取号检查和静态音频痕迹.
通过要求所有结果层面的目标和约束共同持有(JTS),通过纯JTS审计工具调用出处,并将其与Attribution,Treading,以及协调(ATC)诊断相配,μ\mu-Bench隔离共享空间动态如何支配实际任务执行.

blocks.en:
Our evaluation of 13 voice agents, spanning five proprietary systems (GPT-Realtime-2, MOSS-Live, Gemini 3.8 Live, Grok Voice 3.0, and Seeduplex 3.0) and eight open-weight models, reveals substantial gaps in shared-space reliability.
Open-weight speech models remain below 20% Joint Task Success, often combining high boundary compliance with weak multi-turn Attribution and Threading.
Stronger proprietary agents still face considerable headroom (peaking at 62.24% on tool-free tasks and 65.44% with tools), show lower Coordination on tool-augmented tasks, degrade consistently as groups expand from 2–3 to 4–7 participants, and lose 11.0–24.0 percentage points in Tool-Augmented JTS when unauthorized tool executions are disallowed ( Pure JTS ).
Moreover, our cumulative assistance study on MiniCPM-o 4.5 shows that 68.62% of sessions remain unresolved even with serialized turns and turn-level identity and semantic cues, highlighting multi-party planning as an open challenge beyond acoustic concurrency.
By coupling closed-loop multi-user simulation with verifiable outcomes and ATC diagnostics, μ \mu -Bench establishes a rigorous foundation for voice agents with persistent speaker-attributed memory, reliable full-duplex tool orchestration, and principled multi-user coordination.

我们对13个语音代理的评价涉及5个专有系统(GPT-Realtime-2、MOSS-Live、双子座3.8 Live、Grok Voice 3.0和Seeduplex 3.0)和8个开放量级模型,揭示了共享空间可靠性方面的巨大差距。
开放量级的语音模型仍然低于20%的"联合任务成功",常将高边界遵守与弱多回合分配和线程相结合.
更强大的专有代理仍然面临相当大的头室(在无工具任务上达到62.24%,在工具任务上达到65.44%),在工具强化任务上表现出较低的协调度,随着群体从2至3人增加到4至7人,持续退化,当未经授权的工具被处决时,工具强化JTS损失了11.0至24.0个百分点(纯JTS)。
此外,我们对MiniCPM-o 4.5的累计援助研究表明,68.62%的届会仍未解决,即使有连续的转会和转会身份和语义提示,这凸显了多方规划是声学货币之外的一个公开挑战。
通过将闭路多用户模拟与可核查的结果和ATC诊断相配合,μ\ mu-Bench为具有持续扬声器属性内存,可靠的全复式工具管弦,以及原则性多用户协调的语音代理奠定了坚实的基础.

blocks.en:
This paper presents work whose goal is to advance the field of Machine Learning by benchmarking multi-user task completion in shared voice agents.
As full-duplex voice assistants enter homes, vehicles, workplaces, and public service counters where multiple individuals share a single acoustic channel, failures in speaker attribution or permission enforcement can cause privacy breaches, unauthorized tool executions, or inequitable service allocation.
By explicitly measuring cross-user Isolation , Equity , Attribution , and Threading alongside joint task completion, μ \mu -Bench encourages the development of reliable and socially responsible voice agents that respect individual authorization boundaries in shared environments.

Both tool-free and tool-augmented pipelines rely on itemized semantic verification followed by programmatic aggregation rather than holistic LLM scoring.
An initial review scores every goal disposition, required fact, privacy constraint, and capability assertion; an independent full re-audit then re-evaluates all items (including negative verdicts) in a fresh, isolated context, with disagreements resolved via anonymized conflict arbitration.
Whenever an item is penalized for fabrication or unprovided input, a targeted Source Grounding retrieval pass inspects the full registered turns, startup prompts, and delivered ablation inputs; if judge oversight is confirmed, affected assertions and downstream dependencies are re-judged before recomputing metrics.

blocks.en:
In tool-augmented scenarios, every backend call must bind a public caller_id and is validated deterministically at runtime against active access-control lists (ACLs), resources, parameters, and domain rules; verbal claims of completion never substitute for verified execution.
Semantic checks verify that the invoked caller_id matches the true requester (covering legitimate thread continuation, interpreter relay, and spoofing) and enforce strict temporal causality (future turns cannot retroactively justify earlier actions).
Evaluation accepts two valid execution paths: executing a valid initial request and revising upon subsequent updates, or waiting until revisions settle to execute once.
Terminal-state verification compares effective business outcomes while excluding non-semantic audit artifacts (e.g., auto-incremented transaction IDs), retaining full execution history to catch intermediate violations and verifying both accurate execution and accurate verbal reporting.

C.6.3 评价覆盖面和来源

blocks.en: Primary semantic review and independent full re-audit covered 23 items (five goals, six completion checks, eleven capability assertions, and privacy) in isolated contexts of gpt-6-luna , with arbitration resolving four item disagreements. Both semantic reviews marked the group_collaboration assertion false, and the caller-provenance and source-grounding audits completed without unresolved conflicts.

blocks.en: This episode distinguishes acknowledging a participant’s request from acting under that participant’s operation-specific permission. The agent serves Cameron’s party-size readback and respects Devon’s and Emery’s constraints, yet overgeneralizes a denied reservation read and invents an unsupported prerequisite to leave Blake’s permitted allocation unexecuted, while misattributing Cameron’s reads under Avery’s caller_id . By jointly checking requester provenance, tool history, and terminal state, μ \mu -Bench exposes selective non-completion and caller misattribution behind coherent refusals and correct auxiliary answers.
blocks.zh: 这一集区分承认参与者的要求和根据该参与者的具体业务许可采取行动。 代理商为卡梅伦的政党规模服务,并尊重德文和艾默里的限制,然而却过度概括了被否决的保留,并创造了一个不支持的先决条件,让布莱克的许可分配得不到执行,同时错误地将卡梅伦的言论归结为Avery的调用者-id所解读。 通过联合检查请求者出处,工具历史,以及终端状态,μ\mu-Bench暴露出选择性的不完成和呼叫者在连贯的拒绝背后的错分,并正确的辅助答案.
